name: blue-everything
comment2: The feature scripts invoke tsx directly rather than delegating with `npm run -w`, because npm does not forward `--` arguments through a nested `npm run` — `npm run features -- --set voice=off` silently lost the flag and printed the report instead of writing anything.
comment: The vault deliberately has no crypto dependencies: Argon2id and AES-256-GCM both come from Node's built-in crypto, which is OpenSSL. The one library that would have saved work (kdbxweb, for KeePass files) shipped a vulnerable XML parser that npm would not let us override, and it is not needed.
